components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for main workflows like scanning and adding trades
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-text-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-xl); font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button for supplementary actions like exporting and filtering
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: var(--color-secondary); color: var(--color-text-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-lg); font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Form input for text entry like stock search and manual watchlist addition
components.css: .ds-input { background-color: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--color-panel-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--spacing-md); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } .ds-input:invalid { border-color: var(--color-error); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Container component used for cards, modals, and panels requiring premium depth
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background-color: var(--panel-bg); backdrop-filter: var(--blur-fx); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--blur-fx); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-premium); transition: var(--transition-smooth); position: relative; } .ds-glass-panel:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 0 30px -5px var(--glow-purple), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-glass-panel .ds-body { color: var(--color-text-primary); font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Conviction Badge
components.description: Badge component for displaying prediction confidence levels in AI analytics
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-high { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); } .ds-chip-moderate { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #f59e0b; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); } .ds-chip-low { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3); } .ds-chip-loading { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #94a3b8; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle chip for filter selection in range filters and category selectors
components.css: .ds-chip-outline { background-color: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-panel-border); color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-chip-outline-active { background-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-text-primary); border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-chip-outline:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-chip-outline-active:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.9; }

narrative.overview: MomentumScan's design system embodies the precision and reliability of institutional trading terminals while maintaining accessibility for active traders. The interface prioritizes data density and actionable insights through a dark, premium aesthetic that reduces visual fatigue during extended trading sessions. Every element serves a functional purpose - from the conviction badges that communicate prediction confidence to the glass panels that provide depth without distraction.
keyCharacteristics: Dark premium foundation with strategic accent highlights for visual hierarchy
Data-first approach where information density serves decision-making speed
Institutional-grade precision in typography, spacing, and interactive states,
Progressive disclosure patterns to interactive states
Progressive disclosure patterns to manage complexity without sacrificing depth
Consistent interaction language across all modules and workflows

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Data Legibility Rule
rules.body: Body text must maintain 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds for extended readability during market hours.

rules.name: The Glass Panel Rule
rules.body: All containers use glassmorphism with backdrop-filter and subtle shadows for premium depth without breaking the dark aesthetic.

rules.name: The Conviction Clarity Rule
rules.body: Prediction confidence must always be communicated through the standardized conviction badge system with explicit color mapping.

dos: Do use the dark navy primary background (#1E293B) for all main surfaces to maintain visual consistency and reduce eye strain
Do apply the amber accent (#F59E0B) sparingly (≤15% of any screen) for key interactive elements and important data highlights
Do maintain 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text against backgrounds, using almost white (#F8FAFC) for primary text on dark surfaces
Do implement glassmorphism with backdrop-filter and subtle shadows for premium container depth
Do use conviction badges with explicit color mapping to communicate prediction confidence levels
Do follow the 8px/16px/24px spacing scale for consistent rhythm
Do apply 6px/10px/16px radius scale for consistent corner treatment
Do use Geist for body/table data and Cabinet Grotesk for display elements to maintain typographic hierarchy
Do implement explicit hover, focus, active, and disabled states for all interactive components
Do use semantic colors consistently: success (#10B981), error (#EF4444), info (#3B82F6), warning (#8B5CF6), attention (#F97316)
donts: Don't use light or warm-toned backgrounds that increase eye strain during extended trading sessions
Don't use amber accent (>15% of screen) as it diminishes its effectiveness as a highlighting tool
Don't violate contrast ratios - never use muted text on dark backgrounds without ensuring 4.5:1 minimum contrast
Don't use flat containers without depth indicators - always apply glassmorphism or shadow treatments
Don't use ambiguous confidence indicators - always employ the conviction badge system with explicit color mapping
Don't use inconsistent spacing - adhere to the 8px/16px/24px scale for vertical and horizontal spacing
Don't use inconsistent border radii - adhere to the 6px/10px/16px scale for all rounded corners
Don't use decorative fonts for body or data text - stick to Geist for readability at small sizes
Don't ship interactive components without explicit state definitions (hover, focus, active, disabled)
Don't use semantic colors inconsistently - maintain strict mapping of meaning to color across the interface
